files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added
- **Comment lifecycle management (issue #6):** staff can edit any comment, switch a comment between customer-visible and staff-only internal note, and soft-delete it (staff see a "deleted by" note in the thread, customers see a clean thread); helpdesk admins can purge deleted comments permanently for real erasure. Comment authors can edit or delete their own comments within a configurable window (`comment_edit_window_minutes`, default 24h). Edited comments carry an "(edited)" marker on every surface, and edits, deletes, purges and moves are written to the activity log. Available in the web UI and the mobile companion.
- **Selective comment and attachment transfer (issue #7):** staff can select individual comments (bound attachments travel with them automatically) and standalone ticket attachments and move them to another ticket via a search picker. Moves keep the internal flag and original timestamps, clear checklist bindings, are idempotent against retries, and leave an audit line in both ticket threads without leaking the counterpart ticket number to readers who cannot see it. Available in the web UI and the mobile companion.
- **Russian (ru) localization (issue #8):** the app is now fully translated into Russian, including the mobile companion.

### Changed
- The "Mobile license" settings section is hidden until the Prototype Fund grant period ends — the mobile companion cannot launch before that, so the purchase/seat page is temporarily unreachable. The section, its API and all restore wiring stay in place for re-enabling (planned on/after 2026-01-15).

### Fixed
- App-Access user picker: visible "Searching / no matches / search failed" status (aria-live) instead of a silently empty dropdown; Enter picks the highlighted or first result; in-flight searches are aborted on short queries (same for the group picker).

- A non-member carrying `core.defaultapp=ticketcheck` with no provenance at
  all (no flag, marker, or firstrunwizard sentinel — e.g. a mid-write
  leftover) is now unpinned at the next login too, matching the upgrade
  repair step's every-update policy instead of staying trapped until the
  next release (issue #4 follow-up). `files.quota` remains marker-gated so
  admin-set `0 B` quotas are still never touched
- Customer-side comments now actually trigger companion notifications: a
  stale `$user` reference left over from the actor refactor made the
  notification call throw inside its own soft-fail handler, so
  `notifyPublicComment` silently never ran for `addComment` replies
- Settings group pickers (extra groups + requester groups) now flag
  deleted Nextcloud groups with a "Group not found" badge instead of an
  indistinguishable raw group id, so admins can spot and remove stale
  access config
- Dual-role staff (staff group + `helpdesk_requesters`) no longer dead-end
  on their own customer-side tickets: `canPortalViewTicket` unions
  requester-scoped access with staff visibility, so the "My requests"
  deep-link, replies and attachments now work for project members too.
  Dual-role staff may rate their own done tickets (but never other
  customers'), and `/portal/logout` + `/portal/change-password` no longer
  end or misrender their NC-managed session
- **Localization catalog heal** (post-seal corpus pass): restored ~80
  zh_CN/zh_TW strings that were cut mid-sentence plus a truncated Danish
  fragment; fixed a Spanish negation inversion and wrong-word renderings,
  a Swedish wrong-sense value, and Russian entries that dropped clauses
  from their English source
